fixes.summary: Host-agent Prometheus exporter: app_health gauge (gateway HTTP liveness per tenant — closes the #197 blind spot where vm_health=1 but gateway crashlooped), DNAT port pool watermark (used/total/quarantined), host build_info with SHA256 self-hash, loop_tick heartbeat, ssm_agent liveness, and route_failure counter. Health-check Lambda enhanced to surface host-agent metrics endpoint status.

params_changed.name: METRICS_PORT
params_changed.runtime_impact: host-agent now listens on :8899 for Prometheus scraping; no effect on tenant traffic

fixes.summary: Scalable tenant queries: paginated GET /tenants with cursor-based pagination (AES-GCM encrypted cursors via Secrets Manager key), optional GSIs (gsi_host, gsi_status, gsi_rootfs_version) for efficient queries by host/status/version. Feature-gated by config tenant_query.enabled.

params_changed.name: TENANT_QUERY_ENABLED
params_changed.runtime_impact: When false, new query routes return 404; existing /tenants GET unchanged

params_changed.name: PAGINATION_AES_KEY
params_changed.runtime_impact: Used for cursor encryption; required when tenant_query enabled

fixes.summary: Periodic tenant stats aggregation: new openclaw-tenant-stats-writer Lambda (1min EventBridge schedule, scans tenants table, writes summary stats to openclaw-tenant-stats DDB table). New GET /tenants-stats API route exposes the pre-computed stats with DynamoDB Decimal counts normalized to JSON numbers. Feature-gated by config tenant_stats.enabled.

params_changed.name: TENANT_STATS_TABLE
params_changed.runtime_impact: New env var on openclaw-api only when feature enabled

params_changed.name: STATS_SCAN_SEGMENTS
params_changed.runtime_impact: Parallel DDB scan segments for stats writer

fixes.summary: S3 user hooks: optional customer-managed root hook (s3_uri + sha256 + timeout + failure_policy) downloaded and executed at host init before DDB registration. CDK validates hook config at synth; init-host.sh gains {{HOST_USER_HOOK}} placeholder. ha_edge.py grants host-role S3 read on the hook bucket.

params_changed.name: HOST_USER_HOOK
params_changed.runtime_impact: No effect when unconfigured; when configured, hook runs before host registers

fixes.summary: Edge Fluent Bit deployment now fails closed on an empty delivery stream or unresolved template variables, validates the rendered config with --dry-run, and passes the logging bucket, region, and stream through future Edge launch-template userdata.

Remove the unused legacy launch-time DNAT family and make delete reclaim bitmap DNAT, legacy DNAT, Redis route, and the in-process bitmap slot. Missing Redis configuration, Redis deletion failure, or persisted route state without host_id keeps the tenant retryable instead of finalizing a hidden leak.

stop-vm.sh lifecycle lock serialization: stop acquires the same per-tenant flock as launch-vm.sh (fd9) to prevent race between stop and cold-launch. Legacy Firecracker fd9 holder detection avoids deadlock on pre-patch VMs. launch-vm.sh closes fd9 in the Firecracker child (9>&-).

verifications.observable: Prometheus exposition text with openclaw_vm_health, openclaw_app_health, openclaw_host_dnat_ports_*, openclaw_host_build_info, openclaw_host_loop_tick, openclaw_host_ssm_agent_up
verifications.pass_when: HTTP 200 AND all expected metric families present with valid samples
verifications.fail_when: Connection refused (agent not listening on 8899) OR missing metric families

verifications.action: Create a tenant, wait running, curl metrics, check openclaw_app_health{tenant=<id>}
verifications.observable: openclaw_app_health gauge value for the test tenant
verifications.fail_when: gauge absent or == 0 when tenant is running with healthy gateway
Any of the three absent OR _used > _total (accounting error)

verifications.action: curl GET /tenants?limit=2 → check response has 'next_cursor'; curl GET /tenants?cursor=<next_cursor> → check returns next page
verifications.observable: Paginated response with cursor field and correct page size
verifications.pass_when: First page has exactly limit items + non-null next_cursor; second page decrypts cursor and returns subsequent items
verifications.fail_when: 500 (PAGINATION_AES_KEY missing) OR cursor decryption fails OR returns all items ignoring limit

verifications.observable: HTTP status code for invalid cursor
verifications.fail_when: HTTP 500 (unhandled decrypt error) OR HTTP 200 (cursor not validated)

verifications.observable: HTTP response from the new stats route
verifications.pass_when: HTTP 200 with JSON stats object (even if empty when no stats computed yet)
verifications.fail_when: HTTP 404 (route not created) OR 403 (api-key auth not configured on route)

verifications.action: Wait 2 minutes, then aws dynamodb scan --table-name openclaw-tenant-stats --select COUNT
verifications.observable: Item count in tenant-stats table after schedule fires
verifications.pass_when: Count > 0 (writer ran and wrote at least one stats record)
verifications.fail_when: Count == 0 after 2min (schedule not firing or writer erroring)

verifications.action: Decode LT UserData, grep for HOST_USER_HOOK or the hook download block
verifications.observable: Presence of hook placeholder or rendered empty block in UserData
verifications.pass_when: When user_hooks not configured: the rendered block is empty/no-op (host boots normally without hook)
verifications.fail_when: Literal {{HOST_USER_HOOK}} in rendered UserData (template not substituted — host would fail)

verifications.action: On every Edge instance: systemctl is-active fluent-bit; run fluent-bit --dry-run; verify no unresolved FB variables and a non-empty Firehose stream
verifications.observable: Fluent Bit service state and rendered configuration
verifications.pass_when: Every Edge is active, dry-run succeeds, and the configured stream is the selected customer stream
verifications.fail_when: Any Edge is inactive/failed, delivery_stream is empty, or a template variable remains

verifications.action: Create one exact test tenant to running, record bitmap DNAT and Redis route, delete it with keep_data=false, then inspect the same host
verifications.observable: Bitmap DNAT, legacy DNAT, Redis route, bitmap used gauge, VM directory, and Firecracker process
verifications.pass_when: One bitmap rule exists while running; no legacy rule is created; after delete both counts are zero, Redis is empty, bitmap used drops by one, and VM state is absent
verifications.fail_when: A legacy rule appears, route cleanup returns 5xx without remaining retryable, or any exact route/VM state remains after successful delete
verifications.cleanup: DELETE only the exact recorded test tenant ID; never use a prefix wildcard

verifications.action: Launch a tenant; immediately issue stop while launch is in progress (race condition test)
verifications.observable: stop-vm.sh blocks on flock until launch completes, then cleanly stops
verifications.pass_when: Tenant reaches stopped state without 'kill: No such process' errors in stop log
verifications.fail_when: stop-vm.sh kills a half-built VM OR deadlocks (legacy Firecracker holds fd9)

verifications.action: Stop a tenant that was launched BEFORE this patch (Firecracker still holds fd9 from old launch-vm.sh)
verifications.observable: stop-vm.sh detects legacy lock holder and proceeds without deadlock
verifications.pass_when: Log shows 'legacy Firecracker lock holder detected' + tenant stops cleanly
verifications.fail_when: Deadlock (stop hangs on flock forever) OR incorrect PID killed
